sequenceDiagram
    participant p0 as Browser
    participant p1 as Auth Service
    participant p2 as User DB
    p0->>p1: POST /login
    p1->>p2: find user
    p2-->>p1: user row
    p1->>p1: verify hash
    Note over p1: bcrypt cost 12
    p1-->>p0: 200 OK#59; token

sequenceDiagram
    participant p0 as Client
    participant p1 as Server
    p0->>p1: GET /items?page=2
    Note over p0,p1: TLS 1.3 session
    p1->>p1: check cache
    p1-->>p0: 200: [3 items]
    Note over p0: render list
